backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining car listing types, user profiles, and query/update methods including depreciation curve calculation, cross-model search, and access-controlled CRUD operations, with blob storage and authorization mixins included.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single high-confidence feature requirement (REQ-142) about wiring deal score badge rendering and result grouping in CrossModelSearchPage.tsx to the dealScore field.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, hook, and utility in the frontend.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Used Car Price Comparison Scraper' and mounting the app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes, QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider, sticky header navigation with theme toggle and auth, and a profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/ColumnCustomizat: Popover panel component for toggling column visibility and reordering columns via drag-and-drop or up/down buttons, used in the dashboard table.
frontend/src/components/ComparisonExport: A modal panel for exporting comparison data for a specific make/model, with support for saving, renaming, and deleting named filter presets of type 'comparison'.
frontend/src/components/ExportFilterPane: A modal panel for exporting dashboard data as CSV, with support for saving, renaming, and deleting named filter presets of type 'dashboard'.
frontend/src/components/OnboardingEmptyS: An empty-state UI shown when no listings exist, prompting the user to add their first listing manually or import a CSV file.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: A reusable pagination component that renders page navigation buttons, ellipsis for large page counts, and a rows-per-page selector.
frontend/src/components/PriceAlertBanner: A dismissible banner that displays active price alerts when listings matching the alert's make/model are found at or below the target price.
frontend/src/components/PriceStatisticsP: A statistics panel displaying min, max, and average prices, cheapest source, and deal score summaries for a filtered set of car listings.
frontend/src/components/StaleListingRemi: Renders a collapsible panel listing car listings older than 30 days, allowing users to keep or archive each stale listing via the useArchiveListing mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the Internet Identity changes.
Manages dashboard column order and visibility preferences, persisting them to localStorage and syncing with backend user preferences when authenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions, including CRUD operations for listings, user profiles, dashboard stats, depreciation data, and user preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages dark/light theme state with localStorage persistence and backend sync for authenticated users, applying the theme class to the document root.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter and Rajdhani fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for dark and light themes including colors, chart tokens, and sidebar variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/ActivityLogPage.tsx: Page component that displays a searchable, filterable activity log of listing actions (edit, archive, delete, merge, bulk_edit) with relative timestamps and action-specific icons and badge styles.
frontend/src/pages/AddListingPage.tsx: Form page for manually creating a single car listing with fields for make, model, year, price, mileage, condition, and source, including validation and submission via the createListing mutation.
frontend/src/pages/ComparisonPage.tsx: Page that renders interactive price trend line charts for comparing car listings across makes/models, with price drop event annotations, deal scores, mileage-adjusted prices, and export/filter controls.
A search page that lets users query and filter car listings across multiple makes/models, displaying results as cards with deal score badges (Good Deal, Fair, Overpriced), price, mileage, and price-per-mile metrics.
frontend/src/pages/CSVImportPage.tsx: Page that allows users to upload or paste CSV data to bulk-import car listings, with client-side parsing, per-row validation, a preview table, and batch submission via the bulkCreateListings mutation.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: The main dashboard page showing all tracked car listings with sorting, filtering, pagination, inline editing, archiving, deal scores, stale listing reminders, and customizable widget cards per make/model.
frontend/src/pages/DepreciationCurvePage: A page that renders an interactive line chart showing average price depreciation over time for a selected make/model, with stat cards for starting price, current price, and total drop percentage.
frontend/src/pages/DuplicateMergePage.ts: A page that detects near-duplicate car listings, groups them into clusters, and allows the user to select which listing to keep and merge/delete the rest.
frontend/src/pages/MarketOverviewPage.ts: A market overview page displaying aggregate stats including the most tracked car models and a filterable table of recent price-drop listings across all tracked makes and models.
frontend/src/pages/PriceAlertsPage.tsx: React page for managing price alerts, allowing authenticated users to create and delete alerts for specific car make/model combinations and displaying current listings that match or fall below the target price.
frontend/src/pages/SavedSearchesPage.tsx: React page for managing saved search filters, supporting rename, delete, and apply actions that restore filter state to the dashboard via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/SharedWatchlistPage.t: Read-only public page that displays a shared watchlist fetched by a share token from the URL, showing car entries or appropriate empty/error states.
frontend/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx: Authenticated page for managing a personal car watchlist with add, remove, and shareable-link generation functionality.
frontend/src/utils/csvExport.ts: Utility module providing functions to escape CSV field values, build a CSV string from headers and row objects, and trigger a browser file download.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining a dark automotive-themed design system with custom OKLCH color tokens, typography (Inter/Rajdhani), border radii, shadows, and accordion animations. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 57) for an automated used car price comparison system, documenting architectural decisions, known issues, and a list of existing implemented features across scraping, dashboard, charting, and UI theme.
